profile_text.body:
Salesforce is a public company founded in 1999, headquartered in San Francisco, California, and traded under the ticker CRM. Its most recent filing, a 10-K for the period ending 2026-01-31, reported revenue of 41525000000 US dollars. The material harvested from its site centers on Slack, which the company describes as a place to summarize chats, search files, take meeting notes, translate conversations, and automate workflows. Slackbot is described as a personal AI agent in Slack, and the company says AI features are available across all paid Slack plans.

The products tracked are Slack AI, Tableau AI (Einstein), and Salesforce Einstein / Agentforce. Slack AI is noted as embedded in messaging with message-corpus exposure. Tableau AI is noted for natural language queries, CRM data integration, and Trust Layer governance. Einstein / Agentforce is described as CRM-embedded AI and agents. The site says Slack serves as the conversational UI for Agentforce, with agents running in channels, threads, and DMs, and that customer data is not used to train large language models, with LLMs hosted within Slack's AWS virtual private cloud.

The record also lists six MCP servers tied to Salesforce, including ai.cirra/salesforce-mcp for administration and management, several ai.smithery entries for running SOQL queries to explore and retrieve Salesforce data, and cloud.serpent/salesforce-devops for planning deploys, opening pull requests, and triggering pipelines from an AI client. A law exposure record lists California with a count of 281.
